party.title: KTV Party
party.intro: Create a room or join your friends with an invitation code.

party.confirmRemove: Remove this person from the room?

party.stageRecovery: Stage audio was interrupted. Recover or choose an enabled stage, then resume with a countdown.

party.hostMissingWithoutCohost: Host controller disconnected. The queue is preserved and the next song waits for a host or co-host controller.
